name: Call for nature and environmental protection civil organisations (Hungary)
summary: Grants of HUF 1-3 million to registered public-benefit civil organisations in Hungary for nature conservation work such as habitat protection and management, habitat rehabilitation, Natura 2000 tasks and nature monitoring.
reporting: A written report and an invoice summary, sent electronically within 30 days after the funding period ends and by 30 January 2027 at the latest.
